Service-role trusted-roaster worker wrapper; verified admins unlimited, other members shared 12/24h and 15s cooldown. Retains trusted-source verification.
URLs are evidence, not identity: one URL may represent successive releases. Original image bytes are not stored here. Fetch services must independently validate URLs against SSRF.
Server-owned structured projection. Excludes raw shot IDs, account IDs, contributor IDs, private notes and setup names. Only validated eligible projections of verified coffees are visible.
